# clavis audit

<p class="cli-lead">Read the organization audit log</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis audit <command>
```

</div>

Every read, write, reveal, sign-in and admin action is recorded in a tamper-evident audit log. Values are never in it.
